barks.text: Between us, I've got something special for a keen eye like yours, merchant.
Between us, partner, you look like someone who appreciates a genuine find!
Between us, adventurer, you look like a traveler who appreciates quality, eh?
Between us, traveler, I've got things here you didn't even know you needed, until now!
Between us, friend, I bet I've got that missing trinket you didn't even know you were looking for!
Between us, traveler, you've got a sharp eye for the good stuff, don't you?
Between us, wayfarer, I can tell you're a discerning sort just by your gaze.
Between us, my friend, you've got excellent taste; these aren't usually on display!
Between us, friend, you've got good eyes for quality, don't you?
Welcome, welcome! Between us, a discerning eye like yours will spot the real gems.
